rationale: Week 1 2026 and the 2025 archive both showed the incumbent player-prop layer behind the market it scans and worst where it disagreed most: it projects every player alone (no team reconciliation, no redistribution when a teammate is out), its pass/rush split ignores the game script, and no player line knows the opponent. The Price and Stevenson misses were role redistribution after teammates were ruled out. The simulation layer (nfl_edge/sim, sim-1.0.0) replaces the architecture: one Monte Carlo game per slate game on common rows -- score, script-conditional plays and pass rate, Dirichlet-multinomial opportunity over the point-in-time eligible set, opponent-adjusted per-touch efficiency from empirical banks, touchdown allocation -- so every player output reconciles with its team and one distribution prices a whole ladder. The market remains the prior: the reconciled probability re-locates the football distribution toward the market mean by a per-family weight fitted OUT OF SAMPLE on the 2025 archive (weeks 1-9 fit, 10-22 confirm; then all of 2025 for the weight 2026 uses). The question is whether that earned deviation is real signal on contracts Kalshi actually lists.
features: Strictly-prior EWMA team/player/opponent features (features-1.0.0), depth-chart rank at the cutoff, weekly roster status, injury designations and Sleeper availability at the cutoff, the Kalshi-implied game centre (50% crossing of the spread and total ladders). No same-contract quote enters the football-only probability; the market enters only through the game centre and the reconciliation step, both recorded on every row.
target: PRIMARY: paired Brier of the RECONCILED probability versus the quoted midpoint at the newest pre-kickoff snapshot, on settled 2026 player-prop rungs from Week 2 onward, by statistic family (rush_yards, rec_yards, receptions, pass_yards, pass_td, any_td, carries, attempts, completions), game-clustered. SECONDARY: the same for the FOOTBALL-ONLY probability; calibration by |reconciled - mid| band; the share of football deviations that point toward the closing mid.
expected_direction: The reconciled probability is not worse than the market midpoint on any family with a positive fitted weight, and the football-only probability is closer to the market than the incumbent's was (incumbent minus market payout MSE was +0.020 on Week 1). A family whose fitted 2025 weight is 0 is expected to be indistinguishable from the market by construction. If the reconciled Brier is worse than the market on a family at |z| > 2 after 64 games, that family's weight goes to 0 and the family is reported football-only.
test_plan: PREREGISTERED BEFORE ANY PROSPECTIVE 2026 SIMULATION ROW IS SETTLED. Prospective rows are written by scripts/sim/project_week.py to data/shadow/sim on market-data from the moment this code is merged, one file per shadow-pricing cycle, write-once. Week 1 2026 rows exist only as a DEVELOPMENT diagnostic (research/simulation_engine/WEEK1_2026_DIAGNOSTIC.md) and are excluded from the prospective sample. Sample unit: one row per contract at the newest pre-kickoff snapshot. No verdict before 64 distinct games; below that every report prints INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Weights are the constants in research/simulation_engine/reconciliation_weights.json and are not refitted on 2026 outcomes during the season. Uncertainty clustered at the game. No family is promoted to any authority by this hypothesis; promotion is a separate, explicit, owner-approved decision. The reconciliation weights this hypothesis deploys are the ones in research/simulation_engine/reconciliation_weights.json AFTER the point-in-time correction; any weight derived from the pre-correction backtest is void and is not carried forward.
dataset: market-data: data/shadow/sim (prospective rows), data/kalshi/capture (closes), nflverse box scores for settlement; research/simulation_engine for the 2023-2025 walk-forward and the 2025 reconciliation study
result: UNTESTED prospectively. Historical: research/simulation_engine/RESULTS.md (walk-forward 2023-2025 primitives against a prior-only baseline; 2025 Kalshi rungs football-only vs market vs reconciled).
notes: Game families (winner, spread, total, team total) are priced from the market-implied centre and labelled MARKET_CENTRED_GAME; they are H-20260910-026's question and are not part of this hypothesis. The handicap packet ranks only the reconciled disagreement and the raw incumbent disagreement no longer moves a game's review priority. PIT CORRECTION (2026-09-16, before any prospective row was settled): the first version of the walk-forward computed its shrinkage targets (league levels, pooled rates, rate denominators, position rates) over the whole assembled frame, which included the evaluation season, so a week-1 projection's priors had seen week 18. The priors are now fitted on the raw rows of seasons strictly before the evaluation season and frozen on the bundle; the walk-forward rebuilds its frames per evaluation season; features refuse to run without them. Every dependent artifact -- bundles, distributions, walkforward.json, the reconciliation study, the deployed weights and the Week-1 diagnostic -- was deleted and regenerated from the corrected code, and the deployed weights were re-earned under the same fit/confirm rule rather than carried over. Only the close (T-0) is weight-bearing evidence: the historical game centre is the consensus closing line, so T-24h is reported as NON_PIT_DESCRIPTIVE.
